title: Shared item core, core_version 1
description: ADDITIVE ONLY after signing: new optional keys, new enum values and new blocks may be added within core_version 1; nothing is removed, renamed, retyped or tightened. A breaking change is core_version 2 with ARMAGEDOM Lead sign-off. Canonical copy lives in Frankendom-v3 (docs/item-core.md). Ids are stable keys, never infer meaning from one. Extra keys beside the core ones are allowed (each game's extension); a consumer ignores keys it does not know. Ballistics, per-move maps, charges and cut units are never core.

asset.description: Path relative to the owning game's public asset root, extension preferred; a bare stem only where that game's loader documents it. Never a URL.

damage.description: One base value: a fully mastered hit in the held-fire mode.

rate.description: Attacks per second, one base value, same mode.
